model: log(H_final / H_m) = a + b * pvp; OLS on Texas 2000-2025
dec_procedure: On the 10 Dec 2026 report: H_final_hat = H_dec * exp(a_DEC + b_DEC * pvp), with pvp = poor + very poor share of Texas cotton for the last week ending on or before 30 Nov 2026 (NASS Crop Progress).
scoring: Absolute % error vs NASS final Texas upland harvested area (released May 2027), compared with USDA Nov and Dec.
